snippet.title: Zelda 64 Temple 96 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Credit : N64man098
Help And some assets Made By ChrisCube and Valentino
Small Help : Mr mine splat
Link Model By : Ikey Ilex

Download Link Will be Uploaded to the Discord After Premiere: https://discord.gg/MFGC64dAvq

update: no need to join the server here's the plain and simple link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15Yrv3sSBxqDTgpVJA2jW6hqN569PhT_9?usp=sharing

enjoy! but before you go I would like to say this

there's a fantastic project coming out that you might have seen at F3 that is remaking Zelda 64 Alpha into basically a full game experience 
and I will say that it is the best project I have ever seen to this day 

It's not out yet but when the time comes and it is please go show them your love and support they deserve it for such a fantastic mod there coming up with
